fields.statement: Built this branch's rhiza (go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza) and, in a scratch git repo with a proposed and an accepted-but-question-blocked change set, ran rhiza tui app roadmap in a real Rex tab driven with rex send-key. Saw the Backlog heading and one row per change set with short ID, [state], title and '(not ready: ...)' reasons, no JSON; j/k and down/up moved the cursor between change set rows; r reloaded keeping the cursor (a new change set appeared); q quit with exit 0. rhiza tui app roadmap --once output was byte-equal (cmp) to rhiza roadmap --json.

With the built binary in a real Rex tab, enter on a change set row opened its detail: short ID and state, kind 'intention', intent, leaves with statement and acceptance ('export: Export reports / acceptance: A test exports a report'), the blocking questions' statements, and Latest run 'none' or, with a live run journal for the change set, 'ship-change · state running · step build/build'. esc returned to the list with the same row selected.

Built binary in a real Rex tab, with a logging rex shim on PATH that records 'window new' instead of starting a real run and forwards other calls to real Rex. p showed 'Start an interactive plan run ... y/n'; n called nothing; p then y called 'rex window new -s <session> 01M675WMC -c <repo> --json -- <rhiza> run start <cs> --workflow plan' (no --autonomous) and said 'Opened Rex tab 01M675WMC running the plan run'; s then y called the same with 'run start <cs> --autonomous --permission-mode auto'; the app stayed open on the list. o with no run said 'No live run for <cs>'; o with a live (flock-held) run journal whose process names a real Rex block ran real 'rex block inspect' and 'rex focus', and Rex's active window became that tab ('Focused Rex tab block:... of run ...'); after closing that block, o said 'The tab of run ... is gone'.

Built binary in a real Rex tab over a scratch repo. On the proposed change set, a showed 'What-if: accept 01M675WMCPN2QE, proposed -> accepted. Accept it? y/n'; y accepted it (rhiza change show: accepted) and the list reloaded with '[accepted]' and no reasons. In the blocked change set's detail, enter then typing 'Use CSV, quoted "always"' with backspace and enter recorded Decision answer-which-format (statement and quote of the typed text, '(owner)', answers -> which-format); rhiza ready reported the change set ready; rhiza render and rhiza check passed. With two blocking questions, j picked the second and its answer recorded answer-q-two, leaving only q-one blocking.
